::: proof

Applying @thm-quadratic-form with $\matr{S} = \matr{I}_{p \times p}$ (which is symmetric and constant with respect to $\vb$):

$$
\ba
\deriv{\vb}(\tp{\vb}\vb)
&= \deriv{\vb}(\tp{\vb}\matr{I}_{p \times p}\vb)
&& \text{(rewrite with identity matrix)} \\
&= 2\matr{I}_{p \times p}\vb
&& \text{(derivative of a quadratic form, with } \matr{S} = \matr{I}_{p \times p} \text{)} \\
&= 2\vb
&& \text{(identity matrix property)}
\ea
$$

:::
